h1: Lead capture through a natural conversation
overview: A pop up that shouts for an email address annoys people. We build a friendly chat step instead, where the assistant helps with a question first and then offers to send details or a discount by email. We set up the questions, the consent line, the thank you message and the connection to your email list. We test every path, including shoppers who say no, so the chat always stays polite.

faq: Is it legal to collect emails this way?
Rules vary by country, and we are not lawyers. We build with a clear consent line and an unsubscribe path, as many regions expect. Please confirm your wording with your adviser.
Which email tools can it connect to?
Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Shopify Email, Brevo and similar tools. If your tool is less common, we use a form post or a simple connection and tell you what is possible before we begin.
We avoid blocking pop ups. The assistant helps first, asks only once and accepts a no. Frequency rules prevent repeat asks, and we test on a phone to be sure it never covers the page.
They go to your email list or CRM with a tag showing what they asked about. If you want leads sent into a CRM with chat notes, see CRM Sync, available as a separate service.
